summary: net_chunk_000.c is entirely the TDR/TLV packet codec (Tencent TdrBuf.h primitives + TdrBufUtil.cpp debug printers + auto-generated per-struct pack/unpack/print helpers). No RMI dispatch, no message/opcode handlers, no session code here. All msgId=unknown/N/A. The low-level primitives implement the TDR wire format described in the task (LEB128 varints, zigzag, big-endian fixed ints, tag=(field_id<<4)|wire_type). KEY SYSTEMATIC DISCREPANCY vs generated TLV docs: the docs auto-label string fields (wire 5 LEN_DELIM) and sub-struct/array fields (wire 5) as 'int32' with wire-3 tags (e.g. name tag 0x23), but the real pack functions here use wire 5 tags (e.g. name tag 0x25, list tag 0x35/0x45). Doc field offsets for string members are also often wrong. Each Tlv also has TWO pack variants: a LEB128/zigzag variant and a fixed big-endian variant (byte-swapped fixed ints).
